_about: Deliberate differences from the live pages requested by Ashley, plus live behaviour the capture cannot record (hover styles). Applied every time a page is regenerated. Anchors are exact text on the page (masonry: part of an image file name); px = [desktop, tablet, mobile]. path: our URL when it differs from the live slug. mobile_button_padding: [vertical, horizontal] for filled buttons on phones. side_padding: px left/right of the content on tablets and phones. keep_words: never break lines inside a Korean word. last_line_bottom: in those equal-height cards, the last line sits at the bottom. padding_scale: multiply the padding of the box around a text. css: extra CSS (set) on the block around a text, at breakpoints bp (d/t/m).
